sources.title: Dimios45/yam-pick-duster-bspline-joint · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This model commands joints directly — no inverse kinematics at inference. The end-effector counterpart trained on the same 50 takes is Dimios45/yam-pick-duster-bspline-ee; it emits Cartesian poses and does need IK.

sources.title: Dimios45/yam-pick-duster-bspline-ee · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This model emits absolute Cartesian poses and requires inverse kinematics on the robot. The joint-space counterpart — same 50 takes, no IK needed — is Dimios45/yam-pick-duster-bspline-joint. The pair exists to compare action spaces on identical demonstrations.
